## Summary

Explain the user-visible change and link the public issue, if one exists.
English and Russian are welcome; an internal Beads ID is not required.

## Validation

List exact commands and results, including failures and skipped checks.
For docs-only changes, check relative links and commands. For runtime changes,
describe the affected behavior tests. Separate browser fixtures from observed
native TV behavior, and include model/firmware/source when a TV was used.

## Review notes

Describe compatibility, upgrade, documentation, or follow-up considerations.
Confirm the diff contains no account tokens, passwords, authenticated stream
URLs, private keys/certificates, or local configuration. Don't submit sensitive
findings here; email them privately to
[darst94@gmail.com](mailto:darst94@gmail.com).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and contribution guidance.
